grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Reported speech: Imperatives
grammarPoints.rule: To report an instruction, use told + person + to + base verb. For a negative instruction, use told + person + not to + base verb.
grammarPoints.pattern: subject + told + person + (not) to + base verb

chart.title: Reported speech: Imperatives

intro_examples.text: Mom told me to put my pen in my backpack.
intro_examples.jp: 母は私にペンをリュックに入れるように言いました。

intro_examples.text: My brother told me not to break his toys.
intro_examples.jp: 兄は私に彼のおもちゃを壊さないように言いました。

intro_examples.text: They told me to buy another one!

rows.example: Mom told me to put my pen in my backpack.
rows.jp: 母は私にペンをリュックに入れるように言いました。

rows.pattern: told + person + not to + base verb
rows.example: My brother told me not to break his toys.
rows.jp: 兄は私に彼のおもちゃを壊さないように言いました。

rows.example: I'll ask my son not to take it for a swim.
rows.jp: 息子にそれを泳ぎに持って行かないよう頼みます。

rows.example: My brother told me not to break his toys.
rows.jp: 「私のおもちゃ」は「彼のおもちゃ」に変わります。

rows.pattern: never use that with an imperative
rows.example: They told me to buy another one.
rows.jp: 命令文の伝達では that は使いません。

chart.note_rule: Told always needs a person straight after it: told me, told her, told the customer.
chart.note_exception: Not comes before to, never after it: told me not to break, not told me to not break.
chart.note_exception_detail: Said cannot be used this way — you cannot say “She said me to go”. Use told, or said to me that…

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Reported speech: Questions
grammarPoints.rule: To report a wh- question, use asked + person + the question word + normal word order. To report a yes/no question, use asked + person + if.
grammarPoints.pattern: subject + asked + person + what / if + subject + past verb

chart.title: Reported speech: Questions

intro_examples.text: Lisa asked me what she needed to do next.
intro_examples.jp: リサは私に、次に何をすればよいかたずねました。

intro_examples.text: Ken asked me if I could help him.
intro_examples.jp: ケンは私に、手伝ってもらえるかたずねました。

intro_examples.text: Did you ask the store if it was waterproof?
intro_examples.jp: 防水かどうか店にたずねましたか。

rows.pattern: asked + person + what / where / how + subject + verb
rows.example: Lisa asked me what she needed to do next.
rows.jp: リサは次に何をすればよいかたずねました。

rows.example: Ken asked me if I could help him.
rows.jp: ケンは手伝ってもらえるかたずねました。

rows.pattern: the reported question ends with a full stop
rows.example: Ken asked me if I could help him.
rows.jp: 伝えられた質問はピリオドで終わります。

rows.pattern: no do / does / did in the reported clause
rows.example: She asked me what I wanted.
rows.jp: 伝えるときは do / does / did を使いません。

rows.pattern: can → could, is → was, do → did
rows.example: Did you ask the store if it was waterproof?
rows.jp: can は could、is は was になります。

chart.note_rule: A reported question is not a question any more — it takes normal word order and no question mark.
chart.note_exception: Use if (or whether) when the original question could be answered yes or no.
chart.note_exception_detail: Drop the auxiliary: “What do I need?” becomes what she needed, not what did she need.
